switch.incompatibleTitle: This update needs to stop running work
switch.reasonSchema: The new version changes the data format, so it cannot take over while work keeps running.
switch.reasonIpc: The new version's server cannot talk to this version of Pleiad, so it cannot take over while work keeps running.
switch.reasonRuntime: The files to run the new version could not be prepared, so it cannot take over while work keeps running.
switch.reasonJob: Pleiad was started in a way that does not let the new version take over while work keeps running.
switch.reasonCheck: The new version could not be checked, so it cannot take over while work keeps running.
switch.incompatibleWork_one: {{count}} task is running. If you stop it and update, the stopped conversation is kept with ⚠, and Resume continues from where it left off. Waiting approvals are denied.
switch.incompatibleWork_other: {{count}} tasks are running. If you stop them and update, the stopped conversations are kept with ⚠, and Resume continues from where they left off. Waiting approvals are denied.
switch.incompatibleLater: Later keeps running the version from before the update. Pleiad asks again the next time it starts.
switch.stoppersTitle: Some things will stop when Pleiad switches
switch.stoppersMessage_one: The work is done, but {{count}} thing will stop when Pleiad switches (a ! shell, a Codex terminal, and so on). Stop it and switch?
switch.stoppersMessage_other: The work is done, but {{count}} things will stop when Pleiad switches (! shells, Codex terminals, and so on). Stop them and switch?
switch.stoppersLater: Later keeps running the version from before the update. Pleiad switches by itself once nothing is left to stop.
switch.fallback: The new version's server could not start, so Pleiad is running on the previous version.
switch.failed:
Neither the new version's server nor the previous one could start. Restart Pleiad. Your saved conversations are kept.
{{detail}}

quit.scheduledTail: waiting. Nothing is sent while Pleiad is closed.
quit.scheduledTailBoth: waiting. Scheduled messages are not sent while Pleiad is closed; resumes after a usage limit whose reset time has passed happen when Pleiad opens again.
quit.scheduledTailResume: waiting. Any whose reset time has already passed resume when Pleiad opens again.
quit.scheduledLate: When Pleiad opens again, scheduled messages up to an hour late are still sent.
quit.checkFailed: Could not check what is running. Wait a moment, then close again.
quit.busyMessage: Work is still running. If you stop it and quit, the stopped conversations are kept with ⚠ the next time you start Pleiad, and Resume continues from where they left off. Waiting approvals are denied.
quit.abortTimeout_one: Did not quit because {{count}} task did not stop within {{seconds}} seconds. Check the conversations, then close again.
quit.abortTimeout_other: Did not quit because {{count}} tasks did not stop within {{seconds}} seconds. Check the conversations, then close again.
